heading: Record Date

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS NON- CONVERTIBLE 459[***] SECURITIES 460[***]

content:
60. 547[(1) The listed entity shall fix a record date as per sub-regulation (7) of regulation 23 of the
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities)
Regulations, 2021.]
(2) The listed entity shall give notice in advance of at least 548[three] working days (excluding
the date of intimation and the record date) to the recognised stock exchange(s) of the
record date or of as many days as the stock exchange(s) may agree to or require specifying
the purpose of the record date.

footnotes.text:
547 Substituted by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
(Third Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f. 13.12.2024. Prior to the substitution, the sub-regulation read as
under-
“(1) The listed entity shall fix a record date for purposes of payment of interest, dividend and payment of
redemption or repayment amount or for such other purposes as specified by the stock exchange.”

548 Substituted for the words “seven” by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and
Disclosure Requirements) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f. 13.12.2024.
